documents.title: Bambu PLA Sparkle Technical Data Sheet V1.0
Bambu PLA Sparkle Safety Data Sheet (SDS20251127A08)
Bambu PLA Sparkle Hex Code Table
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS and build plate compatibility

notes: TDS rows with no registry key (recorded, not stored): Young's Modulus (X-Y) 1940 ± 230 MPa and (Z) 1660 ± 210 MPa (ISO 527, GB/T 1040); Melt Index 34.2 ± 3.3 g/10 min (210 °C, 2.16 kg); Crystallization Temperature N/A; Saturated Water Absorption Rate 0.44% (25 °C, 55% RH); Printing and Storage Humidity < 20% RH (sealed with desiccant); Bed Surface Preparation PVP Glue; Retraction Length 0.6 - 1.0 mm; Retraction Speed 20 - 40 mm/s; Max Overhang Angle 55 °; Max Bridging Length 30 mm.

TDS p.3 qualitative properties: Odorless; Skin Hazards No hazard; chemically stable under normal storage and handling; insoluble in water; not resistant to acid or alkali; not resistant to some organic solvents; resistant to most kinds of oil and grease; flammable and self-extinguishing in the air; combustion products water and carbon oxides (odorless).

SDS SDS20251127A08 (Nov. 27 2025): not classified under (EC) No 1272/2008; no PBT/vPvB substance or endocrine disruptor; not hazardous goods for IMDG, DOT, ADR/RID and ICAO/IATA transport; section 9 gives no numeric physical property ("No data available").

Mechanical values are printed-specimen results (TDS Specimen Test: nozzle 220 °C, bed 35 °C, 200 mm/s, 100% infill, annealed and dried at 55 °C for 8 h); density, melting and glass transition are material properties (ISO 1183, DSC). The TDS publishes no raw-material (injection-moulded) mechanical values, so no key mixes the two.
TDS p.2 Bending Modulus (Z) row reads "2150 ± 110" with no unit; it is not stored (no registry key for Z values).

Wiki inconsistency for adjudication: the material table's particle-filled guidance (which names PLA Sparkle) says "Always use a hardened steel nozzle" and "Do not use a stainless steel or brass nozzle", while the PLA Usage Guide row for PLA Sparkle says "All standard nozzles are acceptable (excluding 0.2 mm nozzle)" and the store page FAQ excludes only the 0.2 mm stainless steel hotend. The material table's "hardened steel required" column has no PLA Sparkle row. No requires or not_compatible_with relation is recorded for nozzle material; only the 0.2 mm exclusion, which every source agrees on.

Store-page consistency: diameter 1.75 mm and net weight 1 kg agree with the page; density and nozzle temperature are not_found on the page and are supplied here. The page's ± 0.03 mm diameter tolerance is not in the TDS and is left to the page row.
in_the_box is empty: no official in-the-box list exists for this filament (the store page has none; the TDS and SDS give none).

The store page RoHS document (https://store.bblcdn.com/088f0999da0c419a9630876c48842088.pdf, "Filament RoHS") was not in the offline cache and was not read, so safety.certifications is neither stored nor listed as not_published.

No numeric drying, nozzle or bed value was taken from the wiki: neither the material table nor the drying appendix has a PLA Sparkle row, and the material table's table note ② excludes PLA Sparkle from its "PLA" rows.
